skill.name: slack-automation
skill.description: Automate Slack messaging, search, channel management, reactions, threads, and scheduled posts through Rube MCP and the Composio Slack toolkit.
skill.summary: Use Rube MCP to search Slack, manage channels and users, and automate messages, threads, schedules, and reactions.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans around Slack and Rube tool names, not executable shell commands. The real residual risk is the intentional third-party Rube MCP connection, which can process Slack OAuth, workspace messages, and user data. No prompt injection or malicious social engineering was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Clearly disclose that Rube or Composio handles the MCP connection and Slack OAuth, and ask users to review provider policies before enabling it.

remediation.issue: Slack write actions affect live workspaces
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before sending, editing, scheduling, or reacting to Slack messages.

remediation.issue: Broad searches and user listings can expose sensitive workspace data
remediation.suggestion: Prefer scoped searches, least-privilege OAuth scopes, approved channels, and user-selected date ranges.

content.user_title: Automate Slack Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Slack operations often require repeated searches, message updates, and channel checks. This skill guides AI agents through Rube MCP workflows for reliable Slack automation.
actual_capabilities: Connect to Slack through Rube MCP and verify connection status.
Resolve channel, user, and DM identifiers before sending messages.
Send, edit, schedule, and thread Slack messages.
Search workspace messages and expand matching threads.
List channels, users, user groups, and workspace team information.
Add, remove, and inspect emoji reactions on messages.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP server and Slack OAuth connection.
Access is limited by the connected Slack account and granted OAuth scopes.
Search results can be delayed, truncated, or paginated in large workspaces.
It cannot bypass Slack rate limits, private channel membership, or workspace policies.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Incident Updates
use_cases.description: Post clear status updates, reply in existing threads, and preserve message timestamps for later edits.

use_cases.title: Find Engineering Context
use_cases.description: Search Slack for release, deployment, or incident discussions and expand the most relevant threads.

use_cases.title: Schedule Team Announcements
use_cases.description: Resolve the correct channel, prepare announcement text, and schedule delivery within Slack limits.

prompt_templates.title: Send a Channel Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Post this message to #team-updates: The maintenance window starts at 18:00 UTC. Confirm the channel before sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner message posting with channel resolution.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Conversation Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Slack for recent messages about the payment incident in #support, then open the most relevant thread.
prompt_templates.scenario: Search a scoped channel and inspect thread details.

prompt_templates.title: Schedule an Announcement
prompt_templates.prompt: Schedule a reminder in #release for tomorrow at 09:00 UTC about the release checklist review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolve the channel and convert the requested time to Slack scheduling input.

prompt_templates.title: Review Workspace Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Find messages from the last seven days about failed deployments, group them by channel, and suggest which threads need follow-up.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced search, pagination, thread expansion, and human-readable synthesis.

output_examples.output: The skill resolves #marketing, posts the approved reminder, and returns the channel plus message timestamp for follow-up edits.

output_examples.input: Find messages about a delayed release from last week.
output_examples.output: The skill searches Slack, opens relevant threads, and summarizes matching conversations with channel names and message times.

output_examples.input: React to the deployment complete message with a check mark.
output_examples.output: The skill locates the target message, verifies the channel and timestamp, then adds the requested reaction.

best_practices: Confirm channel and user identity before any write action.
Use thread timestamps when replying so updates stay attached to the right conversation.
Honor Retry-After responses and paginate until Slack returns no cursor.
anti_patterns: Posting to channels based only on display names or partial matches.
Reading broad message history when a scoped search would answer the task.
Ignoring Slack OAuth scope errors or rate-limit responses.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It guides Slack message posting, search, thread handling, reactions, scheduling, channel lookup, and user lookup through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does it require Slack authorization?
faq.answer: Yes. The user must connect Slack through Rube MCP and complete Slack OAuth before workflows can run.

faq.question: Can it access private channels?
faq.answer: Only when the connected Slack account or app has access and the required OAuth scopes are granted.

faq.question: Can it send direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can resolve users, open or reuse a DM channel, and send the approved message.

faq.question: Does the skill store Slack data?
faq.answer: The skill file does not define data storage. Users should review Rube, Composio, and Slack data handling policies.

faq.question: What should teams verify before use?
faq.answer: Teams should confirm the third-party MCP trust boundary, granted Slack scopes, and approval rules for write actions.
